title: pwe-projectefed-undisputed
label: Scott Curtis

won.source: The fed's own New Years Resolution results: "The winner of the main event match tonight, in the ladder match for the Undispued Title. The first ever PWE Undispuetd Champion, Scott Curtis!" (/promotions/pwe-projectefed/archive/new-years-resolution-2003-01-25.html).

how: Won a four-man ladder match against Lynx, Micheal Flash and Christian Masters, pulling the belt down after the president dropped Flash out of the ring with a Van Terminator.
note: Still champion on the fed's own Champions page of 13 February 2003, with Lynx named his first contender; the record ends there.

title: pwe-projectefed-entertainment
label: Adam Van Dam

won.source: The fed's own New Years Resolution results: "Winner of this TLC Entertainment Title Match! The first ever PWE Entertainment Champion is none other then the presidet, The Whole Fuckin' Show, Adam Van Dam!" (/promotions/pwe-projectefed/archive/new-years-resolution-2003-01-25.html).

how: Won a Tables, Ladders and Chairs match against Carl, who had attacked him backstage before the bell; pinned him after a fall through a table off the entrance ramp.
note: Still champion on the fed's own Champions page of 13 February 2003 and carded to defend against Micheal Flash the same night; the result was never captured.

title: pwe-projectefed-hardcore
label: Andre' Sanders

won.source: The fed's own New Years Resolution results: "The winner of the match and the first ever hardcore champion, Primetime, Andre' Sanders!" (/promotions/pwe-projectefed/archive/new-years-resolution-2003-01-25.html).

how: Beat Justice Paine in the inaugural PWE Hardcore Championship match.
note: Still champion on the fed's own Champions page of 13 February 2003, with Walter Parker named his first contender.
